title: Bride Showing Garter on Sidewalk, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photograph, Michigan
description: A playful candidate snapshot captured outdoors on a residential sidewalk in Michigan during the 1950s. The bride, wearing a traditional white lace wedding gown with a veil and cross pendant, lifts the front of her skirt to reveal her lace garter. A vintage automobile with a Michigan license plate is parked along the curb to the left, while groomsmen or guests stand on the sidewalk in the background.
